provider: CityUHK School of Energy and Environment BSc Environment and Sustainable Business curriculum
note: The official 2025-cohort Programme page publishes 58 unique course codes across named Gateway Education and School courses, the 15-credit School Requirement, 76 credits of SEE and College of Business core courses, and an 18-course elective pool from which 9 credits are required. The page metadata states a 131-credit graduation minimum while the curriculum introduction says 130 credits; the visible component headings total 31, 15 and 85 credits, but this conflict is not resolved by arithmetic inference. Distributional Gateway Education remains open and the MA alternatives and elective selection require manual review. The complete coded union is browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
